body:
## Summary

- Patches the `prd` CLI so a full PRD pipeline can run to a clean end on a **greenfield project** (no source code, only planning artifacts). Found while producing the TUIBBS V1 MVP PRD — every fix is in response to an observed halt or wrong-result on that run.
- After these patches: a TUIBBS V1 PRD pipeline that previously HALT-looped at `build-task-file` (Min lines: 18/400) now completes end-to-end with all four QA gates green (`assembly`, `structural-qa`, `qualitative-qa`, `present-complete` all PASS).

## What changed

**`executor.py`** (155 lines)
- Honor `resume_from` (Stage A skip-until; Stage B targets skip all of Stage A). Previously stored but never consulted.
- Stage B sub-stage resume + on-disk-artifact idempotence in `_execute_stage_b` so a resume from `assembly` doesn't redo ~45 minutes of investigation/synthesis.
- Plumb `step_id` into `_build_prompt` (three call conventions; legacy bare-config still works).
- `_resolve_step_content`: add an `assembly` special-case that resolves the largest PRD-like `.md` under `results/` / `task_dir` / `task_dir.parent`. Without this the assembly gate's `min_lines=800` always failed on ~30-line NDJSON commentary.
- `_STEP_ARTIFACT_FILES`: add `research-qa`, `synthesis-qa`, `structural-qa`, `qualitative-qa` → `qa/qa-*-*.md` so QA gates read the report files, not NDJSON.

**`prompts.py`** (245 lines)
- `build_task_file_prompt`: preserve-guard. If a valid `TASK-PRD-<slug>.md` already exists (≥400 lines, phase headings, no "see above" in checklist items, parallel keywords in phases ≥2), instruct Claude to read+confirm only. Stops `build-task-file` from silently rebuilding a passing task file as a 20-line stub on resume.
- `build_investigation_prompt` / `build_web_research_prompt` / `build_synthesis_prompt`: **dual-mode signatures**. The original definitions took positional args (`topic, agent_type, files, ...`) but the executor's `_build_prompt` always called them `(config, *, context_summaries=...)` — every parallel Stage B agent `TypeError`'d before subprocess launch, so research / web / synth files were never written and the `research-qa` gate then failed on 18 lines of NDJSON. New entry points accept either calling convention and derive per-step args from `research-notes.md` (Agent N block), the Agent 7-9 mapping (web research), or `load_synthesis_mapping()` (synthesis). Legacy positional callers still work via `_render_*_prompt` helpers.
- `build_assembly_prompt`: preserve-guard. If a heavyweight assembled PRD already exists in `results/` (≥800 lines, has the 5 PRD critical sections, no placeholder text), instruct Claude to read+confirm only. Avoids a ~25 min rebuild on resume.

**`commands.py`** (24 lines)
- `prd resume` accepts `--product` / `--output` / `--tier`. Previously a resume of a pipeline whose original run used a non-default `--output` derived its task_dir from defaults and crashed at the first prompt builder that tried to read `research-notes.md`.

**`gates.py`** (6 lines)
- `_check_verdict_field` regex accepts `**Verdict:** PASS` (standard markdown bold with the colon inside the bold span), not only `**Verdict**: PASS` / `Verdict: PASS`. The QA reports the prd CLI's own subagents authored used the inner-colon form, but the previous regex rejected it — both structural-qa and qualitative-qa gates failed on otherwise-valid reports.

## Companion artifact

A separate PR in the TUIBBS repo (IronbellyOrg/TUIBBS#3) lands the actual PRD these patches enabled, plus the full evidence trail (8 research files, 3 web research files, 9 synthesis files, 4 QA verdicts) — that PR is the integration test for this one.

## Test plan

- [ ] `uv run python -c "from superclaude.cli.prd import prompts, executor, commands, gates"` imports clean.
- [ ] `make test` still passes (no existing test should have depended on the broken builder signatures or the NDJSON-fallback paths).
- [ ] `superclaude prd resume --help` shows `--product`, `--output`, `--tier`.
- [ ] On a heavyweight PRD run: `_check_verdict_field("**Verdict:** PASS")` returns True (was returning a "no verdict found" string).
- [ ] Stage B parallel investigation agents successfully spawn and write `research/NN-*.md` files (was: 0 files, all agents TypeError'd).
- [ ] A `prd resume assembly --product <x> --output <path>` skips Stage A and Stage B sub-stages whose outputs exist.
